pages.text: $(italic)Formerly living. Undead mechanics apply. The pack's most punishing race in daylight, most powerful at night.$()$(br2)$(bold)Dark Power$() — +20% damage dealt between 8pm and 4am (in-game time). Stacks with class bonuses.$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$() — Permanent night vision. No visual difference from Human during the day.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Sunlight Weakness$() — Direct sunlight: burn effect like a zombie. Helmets and shade prevent this. Plan around it.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Penalty$() — Natural regen and most healing potions 30% less effective. Life Steal and Paladin auras unaffected.$(br2)$(bold)Next: keep a helmet equipped from your first day — sunlight is your real enemy.$()
